anomaly_mapping: the source's own filename prefix: clips named anomaly_id_00_* are the dataset's labelled anomalies, normal_id_00_* its labelled normal operation; the train split is all-normal by dataset construction
channel: 0 = the only channel; source clips are 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM
decode: stdlib wave -> int16 -> float64, raw PCM integers, no scaling (identical to dcase_valve_adapter.py)
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (MIMII / DCASE2020 Task 2 development dataset)
source_url: https://zenodo.org/record/3678171 (DCASE2020 Task 2 development set, derived from the MIMII dataset, https://zenodo.org/record/3384388)
subset_rule: every id_00 clip of this machine type, sorted by name; train -> fit/, test -> eval/; first 20480 samples stored
